Post-C1 content shape confirmed on the walk: Mapa Inicial runs 3 activities and the C1-bumped lessons (l15-l17, version 2) are served by the same generated read model without touching this standalone journey's flow.

First-hand QA observation walk 2026-09-04 19:30-19:31Z (chromium, fresh profile, OS dev surface with local engine bridge at PR #267 head 0a2f94f8; hosted MOTOR served same-origin from the engine dev server). 'Entrar na escola' opened the hub showing '0 competências verificadas' — canonical competence stays separate (ev/os-2-hub.png). The C1 dev mission /mission/dev/l15 ('Quando usar IA e quando não usar', 'Simulação hospedada · 4 min') mounted the hosted LiteracyDojo mission in the mission iframe and played the version-2 3-activity lesson through understand/respond/apply (ev/os-3-l15-intro.png, ev/os-4-l15-act1.png); the host kept 'Estado canônico ... 0 verificadas · sem alteração local' distinct from local completion during the run. Finishing all three activities took the host mission status to 'Evidência: Veredito PASS' via the independent bridge (ev/os-5-l15-verdict.png); returning to the hub retained 'XP local 25 / Meta 25/25' and offered the next step ('Próxima missão · 4 min — IA não é uma fonte de verdade') (ev/os-6-hub-after.png). Observer response: I can state the visible result (independent PASS verdict, local XP awarded, canonical competence unchanged) and the supported next action (named next mission with title and minutes).

First-hand QA observation on the same walk: with the local bridge routes (/__dojo/bridge/v1/*) aborted at the network layer, a completed hosted l16 mission ('Seu primeiro código com um assistente de IA', 3 activities) showed the explicit degraded status 'Verificador indisponível' with the visible retry affordance 'Tentar verificação novamente' and no false 'Veredito PASS' and no fabricated completion (ev/os-7-degraded.png). After releasing the routes, clicking the visible retry affordance moved the mission back into verification ('Aguardando verificador independente') without resetting the session or evidence identity; the completed state then saved and 'Voltar ao hub' returned normally (ev/os-8-recovered.png). Degradation is visible, honest, and recoverable using only the visible state — no repository or developer intervention.

Observed first-hand: after completing the hosted l15 and l16 missions, a reload kept the hub session and the app's own IndexedDB retained both completions (missionStatusByKey dev:l15=completed, dev:l16=completed, read after the reload) with 'XP local 25 / Meta 25/25' intact (ev/os-9-returning.png). Re-entering /mission/dev/l15 on the same profile opened the mission shell directly with no onboarding repeat (ev/os-10-l15-returning-reentry.png). The boundary stays visible on the surface itself: the mission page keeps 'Estado canônico ... 0 verificadas · sem alteração local' and the hub counter 'competências verificadas' separate from local progress — continuity is demonstrably same-browser-profile only, with no cross-device sync claim anywhere on the observed surfaces.
